reason: The console and arming plug are the only available pieces, and the goal explicitly calls for fitting the plug.
expectation: The plug should arm the console and allow the ascent command.

effect: The plug both armed the circuit and triggered the ascent command, completing the chapter in one decision.
reaction: The shrinking cave and panels made the departure feel like a fitting conclusion, although the action itself was the only obvious choice.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the plug was worthwhile for its payoff: the departure connects the repaired lander to the home and infrastructure left below.

leastWorthwhile.text: The decision itself offered little to puzzle over: the goal named the plug and console, and no other pieces were available.

surprise.text: I expected the plug to enable ascent, but the same action also pressed START rather than requiring a separate command.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless; the arming plug and guarded start were clear flight controls, though their combination into one action simplified the procedure.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what the laboratories discover about the specimens, though this chapter alone offered too little gameplay to make continuation compelling on that basis.
